{
  "format": "llmario-theme-pack-reference",
  "packVersion": 1,
  "id": "marioai-reference-complete",
  "title": "MarioAI Complete Reference Theme Pack",
  "contract": {
    "resourceKinds": [
      "ground",
      "block",
      "pickup",
      "actor",
      "decoration",
      "effect"
    ],
    "coordinates": "world pixels; anchors normalized from top-left (0,0) to bottom-right (1,1)",
    "policy": "The engine owns behavior; this pack binds engine nouns, capabilities, and states to presentation.",
    "engineVocabulary": {
      "nouns": [
        "actor",
        "block",
        "decoration",
        "hazard",
        "pickup",
        "platform",
        "player",
        "projectile",
        "structure",
        "terrain",
        "walker"
      ],
      "capabilities": [
        "armored",
        "autotile",
        "carry",
        "climbable",
        "coin",
        "collectible",
        "duck",
        "emerge",
        "extraLife",
        "goalPresentation",
        "grow",
        "horizontalFlight",
        "jump",
        "move",
        "movingPlatform",
        "patrol",
        "projectilePower",
        "retract",
        "run",
        "shell",
        "shoot",
        "solid",
        "solidTop",
        "stompHazard",
        "stompable",
        "transport",
        "walker",
        "waveFlight"
      ]
    },
    "bumpTriggerTypes": {
      "dispenseContents": {
        "effect": "dispense the explicitly configured reward object"
      },
      "temporarySpin": {
        "effect": "run an explicitly configured temporary non-colliding spin phase"
      }
    }
  },
  "attribution": {
    "source": "medovina/MarioAI resources",
    "license": "themes/marioai_theme_files/LICENSE",
    "repository": "https://github.com/medovina/MarioAI"
  },

    "sky",
    "background",
    "world",
    "actors",
    "foreground"
  ],
